declaring_sources.budget_dimensions: budgets/envelope.py LIMIT_DIMENSIONS and the Y05 bounded-budget attestation (composed)
declaring_sources.surrogate_token: surrogate-triage-report schema acceptance token, read positionally

all_completion_and_external_effects_reso.mechanism: the reconciliation, budget, surrogate and authority sub-receipts each re-derive their own hashes, the final verdict binds all four sub-receipt hashes, and every record is deterministic under caller-supplied ids with no clock or randomness

governing_schemas_authority_boundaries_f.mechanism: reconciliation stages, budget dimensions, the surrogate acceptance token and the promotion-commit capability are read from their declaring owners (composed or imported, never restated), and the gate holds no canonical enum value as a literal after renaming three own collisions (capability_id, qualification_passed, accepted_count), proven by the package scan and the repository EF4-I22 gate 5/5

happy_negative_crash_resume_adversarial_.mechanism: caller-declared per-stage counts are reconciled against the composed E05 ledger (submitted == admitted + refused fan-in), and a silent partial fan-in, an orphan effect, a count declaration mismatch, an unbounded or overrun budget dimension, and a surrogate acceptance above its ceiling are each refused by their own code

no_candidate_model_prompt_backend_or_hoo.mechanism: the scale run acquires no evaluator, holdout or promotion authority: promotion capability is grounded in the imported canonical constant, a mutable-search holder granted protected authority refuses SCALE_RUN_ACQUIRES_PROMOTION_AUTHORITY, and a numeric score bound into a promotion decision refuses SCORE_BOUND_INTO_PROMOTION_FIELD

independent_review.evidence: review.md (author: parallel agent; reviewer: primary session; actor_independence between author and reviewer holds, external certification does not)
